name: sample_overlay
description: Render one frame of an overlay JSX to PNG via Puppeteer; optionally return per-element bounding-box and overflow measurements as JSON.

input.description: Absolute path to the overlay JSX file

output.description: PNG file at the requested output path. In --measure mode, stdout is a JSON object with pngPath and measurements keys instead of a bare path.

params.name: overlay
params.description: Absolute path to the JSX overlay file

params.name: props
params.description: Props JSON string passed to the overlay component

params.name: measure
params.description: When set, return per-element bounding-box and overflow data as inline JSON on stdout
